Class SyntaxController

java.lang.Object
it.unipd.nonsense.controller.SyntaxController
Direct Known Subclasses:
NoSyntaxTreeController, SyntaxTreeController
public abstract class SyntaxController extends Object
Abstract base controller for syntax-related views in the application. Handles common functionality for sentence generation and navigation between views.
